notes: The drawer was empty because it never rendered. #fm-header-user is a descendant of .wrap > .row:first-child, and that row was display:none, which removes the whole subtree from the box tree. Every drawer rule in mobile.css was therefore decorating boxes that were never generated, since 1.3.0. The header chain is now kept in the box tree at zero height and the wordmark block is hidden instead. This is the first cause of the reported freeze; the four gaps closed in 1.3.6 are what made it unrecoverable rather than merely empty. CLIENT ONLY, no restart, hard refresh required.
